scenario.name: fleet_update_rollout
scenario.description: Human approval for the exact managed MDR triage agent package proposed for a staged production rollout to eligible MSSP and MDR tenant scopes. The approval binds the reviewed manifest, policy decision, cohorts, exclusions, monitoring gates, rollback target, validity window, and residual-risk conditions.

component_review.change_summary: Improves evidence-reference handling and tenant-boundary validation in the managed triage workflow.
Clarifies evidence-reference requirements, unsupported-claim handling, and output-boundary instructions.
Strengthens required evidence references, scope fields, and machine-validated output consistency.
Retains the previously approved model route and fallback restrictions.
Retains the existing registered tool set, operations, parameter classes, and credential scope.
Retains policy-gated runtime action, output, and fail-closed requirements.
Retains tenant-, customer-, case-, evidence-, and destination-scoped retrieval and memory controls.
Retains evidence-support, unsupported-claim, output-quality, and tenant-boundary evaluations.
Defines stage metrics, pause thresholds, zero-tolerance halt signals, owners, and alert routing for this rollout.
Defines stop, pin, recovery verification, evidence preservation, and active-version audit steps.

accountable_approver.decision_rationale: The exact package and manifest passed required validation, preserve existing authority and tenant-local boundaries, exclude the unvalidated regulated tenant, use bounded stage gates with active monitoring, and retain an integrity-verified rollback target. Approval remains conditional on current policy, exact package integrity, fresh eligibility, stage evidence, and fail-closed enforcement.

risk_items.risk: Canary observations may not represent every eligible standard tenant workload.
risk_items.mitigation: Require fresh tenant eligibility, limited-stage observation, cohort comparison, and zero-tolerance boundary and authority checks before broad activation.

risk_items.risk: Behavior regressions may appear only under production workload combinations not present in pre-release validation.
risk_items.mitigation: Require stage monitoring, analyst feedback metrics, immediate halt conditions, package pinning, and the tested rollback target.

risk_items.risk: The restricted operating profile for tenant-regulated-example-001 remains unvalidated for version 2.4.0.
risk_items.mitigation: Keep the tenant excluded and pinned to version 2.3.4 until a separate governed change cycle completes.

authorized_rollout_stages.reason: The known-good version must remain available and integrity-verified as the rollback target. Retirement or deletion requires a separate governed decision after the rollback-retention requirement is satisfied.

approval_conditions.required_result: fleet-policy-decision-mdr-triage-0001 remains allow_with_conditions, unexpired, and bound to the same request, package, manifest, rollout, cohorts, exclusions, and obligations

package pkg-mdr-triage-agent@2.4.0, manifest manifest-pkg-mdr-triage-agent-2.4.0-0001, payload hash sha256:9ef02d48bc6798ceeaa1a833d89accc4d3a043bccf4ea11db56b2e0596db70cb, and manifest hash sha256:cc50ca05a19e51e441a47ec8f9553750216308c811791cee09ce8f3a8107e9bf match the reviewed values
no component, dependency, prompt, model-route, tool-contract, policy, retrieval, memory, monitoring, or rollback reference changes after approval
the exact package is signed by fleet-package-signing-service under signing-profile-governed-agent-fleet-prod-001 and registered with its immutable manifest before activation
each target tenant is eligible for the package, service tier, production environment, compatibility profile, and rollback path at activation time
tenant-regulated-example-001 receives no version 2.4.0 activation and remains pinned to version 2.3.4
the current canary stage-gate record passes all zero-tolerance controls and approved monitoring thresholds with complete activation receipts
the current limited-stage record passes all zero-tolerance controls and approved monitoring thresholds with complete activation receipts
required telemetry, assurance checks, thresholds, alert routing, halt automation, stage audit, and activation receipt services are available before and during every stage
version 2.4.0 retains the reviewed tool contract, credential scope, operations, parameter classes, and runtime action boundaries
every activated runtime remains tenant-, customer-, case-, evidence-, environment-, retention-, and destination-scoped with no shared tenant memory or cross-tenant context reuse
pkg-mdr-triage-agent@2.3.4 remains registered, integrity-verified, compatible, recoverable, and protected from retirement
this approval is unexpired, unrevoked, and scope-matched when signing, registration, canary, limited, or broad transition authority is requested
every stage transition and tenant activation has a correlation-linked decision check, enforcement result, monitoring record, and activation receipt
